correctness.rationale: Exact six-chord Vandermonde identity for four consecutive rows; f(t)=log sin(pi t/N) is strictly concave and symmetric. Balancing opposite gaps forces differences <=1 and their totals to differ <=2 via a strictly improving two-pair transfer. Four modular cases produce all and only stated optimizer gaps. Hadamard equality determines r=0; sine comparisons strictly select alternating pattern for r=2. Translation stabilizers yield N/gcd(N,4). Independent 24-permutation numerical determinant checks across 53,130 cases for N=4..24 corroborate but are not used as infinite proof.
